memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, works full‑time as accountant, walks 30 min daily.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 3/5 (recall 1, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen, plan for formal neuropsych assessment.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up‑and‑go 9 seconds – low fall risk.
medicines: 6 regular (cholecalciferol loading, atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, fenofibrate, levetiracetam, lamotrigine) – polypharmacy, request Beers‑criteria review.
mood: reports occasional worry about work deadlines, denies depression.
carers: husband Ramesh Kumar.
goal: "Stay seizure‑free and keep my energy up for my job."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Vitamin D panel: 25‑OH vitamin D 14 ng/mL (ref 30‑100), calcium 9.2 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5), phosphate 3.4 mg/dL (2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 162 mg/dL (<100), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40), triglycerides 210 mg/dL (<150). LFT: ALT 22 U/L, AST 20 U/L, ALP 70 U/L (normal). CK 85 U/L (norm 30‑200).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
cholecalciferol 60000 IU PO once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU OD.
atorvastatin 10 mg PO HS.
rosuvastatin 10 mg PO OD.
fenofibrate 145 mg PO OD.
levetiracetam 500 mg PO BD.
lamotrigine 50 mg PO BD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: EEG: awake and sleep‑deprived recording shows no epileptiform discharges; background rhythm normal for age.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling a bit more tired in the afternoons since starting the statins, but my seizures are still under control. I’m worried about the vitamin D pills causing stomach upset – I’ve taken them with breakfast and haven’t noticed any nausea.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:

cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (annual due Oct 2025); will assess next visit.

medicines: 6 regular (cholecalciferol now 1000 IU OD after loading, atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, fenofibrate, levetiracetam, lamotrigine) – polypharmacy, note Beers review pending.
mood: denies depression, notes occasional work stress.
carers: husband Ramesh Kumar.
goal: "Reduce afternoon fatigue and keep my lipid numbers improving."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
cholecalciferol 1000 IU PO OD (maintenance).
atorvastatin 20 mg PO HS (increased from 10 mg).
rosuvastatin 10 mg PO OD (unchanged).

levetiracetam 500 mg PO BD.
lamotrigine 50 mg PO BD.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:

falls: 0 falls, gait normal, TUG 9 seconds – low risk.

mood: stable, denies anxiety or depression.
carers: husband Ramesh Kumar.
goal: "Maintain seizure freedom and keep bones strong."
